top_choice_rationale: Targeted protein degradation is a new design principle, a heterobifunctional molecule inducing proximity between a chosen protein and an E3 ligase, with tunable ternary-complex cooperativity, confirmed across many laboratories and already in clinical trials, and no earlier prize covers it. Crews and Deshaies conceived it and Ciulli's structure-guided VHL ligands made it a general design discipline, so P001 gives the cleanest single-achievement allocation, with the citation limited to the PROTAC concept. The cereblon glue strand (Handa, Ito, Gray) is left unrecognised and no degrader is yet approved, which I accept. If the committee decides the two strands are inseparable, my fallback is base editing in P002.
